tracker.euros_help: Cash: real winnings in €. Tournaments: result of each tournament (prizes + bounties + tickets − buy-ins). Otherwise: in big blinds.
tracker.eur_cash_only: In €, only cash hands have a direct value; tournaments are counted per tournament (Tournaments tab).

graph.help_bb: "At showdown" = hands that reached showdown; "Without showdown" = pots won or lost before. A falling non-showdown line means you give up too many pots.
graph.title_tourney: Tournaments: cumulative result (€), tournament by tournament
graph.help_eur: Real result of each tournament: prizes + bounties + tickets − (buy-in + fee) × entries. Tournaments without a Winamax summary are not counted.

editor.name: Display name
editor.help: A stat is a ratio: "times / opportunities". Example: cnt_3bet / opp_3bet = your 3-bets divided by your 3-bet opportunities. Operations: + - * / ( ) and if(condition, then, else). Available counters:
editor.help_where: Condition: position = 'BTN', game_type = 'cash', stack_bb < 20, players = 3… combined with and / or / not.
editor.pick: Pick a stat on the left to edit it, or create your own.

tracker.export_csv_hands: Export up to 1,000 hands as CSV

review.title: Session review
review.tilt: Careful: you played many more hands than usual this session (VPIP +10 points or more). Possible tilt or fatigue.
review.disclaimer: These tips come from classic poker rules applied after the fact to finished hands: things to look at again, not a verdict. Solver analysis comes in phase 6.
review.nothing_to_review: Nothing special to review this session. Well played!

open_limp.title: Open limp
open_limp.why: Entering the pot first by just calling the big blind is rarely profitable: raise to take the initiative, or fold.

weak_shove.title: Shove with {{hand}} at {{stack}} bb
weak_shove.why: With more than 15 bb, shoving a weak hand risks a lot to win the blinds. At this depth a normal raise or a fold is usually better.

raise_fold_short.title: Raise-fold at {{stack}} bb
raise_fold_short.why: With 12 bb or less, raising without going all-in then folding cost you {{lost}} bb. At this depth it is usually shove or fold.

premium_fold.title: Folded {{hand}} preflop
premium_fold.why: {{hand}} is one of the 5 best starting hands. Folding it preflop against so little action is almost always a mistake (barring extreme ICM).

sb_flat.title: Small-blind call with {{hand}}
sb_flat.why: Calling a raise from the small blind means playing out of position with the big blind still behind. 3-bet or fold is usually better.

river_call_lost.title: Lost river call ({{lost}} bb)
river_call_lost.why: You called a big river bet (at least half the pot) and lost. Replay it: did your opponent usually have better on that line?

big_fold.title: Folded after investing {{lost}} bb
big_fold.why: You folded after putting in a big part of your stack. Either go all the way or stop earlier: find the street where you should have decided.

steal_won.title: Successful steal (+{{won}} bb)
steal_won.why: Folded to you, your raise took the blinds unopposed. These small pots add up.

three_bet_won.title: Winning 3-bet with {{hand}} (+{{won}} bb)
three_bet_won.why: Your preflop re-raise paid off: you took the initiative and won the hand.

cbet_won.title: C-bet takes the pot (+{{won}} bb)
cbet_won.why: After raising preflop, your flop bet made your opponent fold: good continuation.

value_bet.title: Value bet paid (+{{won}} bb)
value_bet.why: You bet or raised the river and got called by worse: you got the most out of your hand.

short_shove.title: Good shove at {{stack}} bb with {{hand}}
short_shove.why: With 10 bb or less, shoving first in with a solid hand is the right strategy.

big_pot.title: Big pot won (+{{won}} bb)
big_pot.why: One of the big hands of your session: replay it to see what worked.

leaks.intro: Your stats against winning-player targets, by format. "Leak" = certain even allowing for luck (95 % confidence interval). "Watch" = keep an eye on it. Edit targets in Settings → leaks/targets.toml.
leaks.not_enough: Not enough hands yet to find leaks (at least 20 opportunities per stat).
leaks.impact: Your result in this spot: {{done}} bb/100 when you do it, {{not}} bb/100 when you don't.

grid.help: Row and column = the two cards. Above the diagonal: suited (s); below: offsuit (o); diagonal: pairs. Hover a cell for details.

bankroll.none: No movement yet. Add your first deposit to track your bankroll.
bankroll.rule_ok: Your bankroll is {{n}} average buy-ins ({{avg}}). Above 30 you have room.
bankroll.rule_low: Careful: your bankroll is only {{n}} average buy-ins ({{avg}}). At least 30 buy-ins is advised for tournaments: move down or top up.

playmode.title: Locked while playing
playmode.why: A poker table is open. Study tools (solver, trainer, ICM, preflop ranges, session review) are locked while playing, because real-time assistance is banned by the rooms. They unlock 60 seconds after the last table closes.
